analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($191.95) vs SMA5/20/50 ($202.15/$204.24/$193.14) — Below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($163.06/$138.79) — Maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (74.9%) + Current price range is in a pullback phase from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (61.3 → 42.8) — Staying in oversold territory, indicating weakness.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (1.8973 → -3.2932) — Worsening, confirming downtrend.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Near lower band $173.80) + Bandwidth 29.81% indicates expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($181.00) — Based on Pivot S1 ($168.23) and 20-day low ($174.14).
· Swing Resistance ($196.41) — Below 5-day high ($219.18) and Bollinger upper band ($234.68).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low unconfirmed, potential Lower High) — Indicating downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.03x vs 5-day average) — Moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — Requires observation for indicator improvement.
